limitations: Exact historical verdict and stated assumptions only; migration makes no new scientific inference.

legacy.claim: An explicitly boost-violating local substrate equation yields a galactic \(m=1\) dipole at an observable amplitude — at or above the delayed-center toy scale \(2\times10^{-3}\), let alone the observed lopsidedness scale ~0.1 — with breaking parameters that survive the sourced walls
legacy.evidence: **Closed (ORB-11175, [Branch C](branch-c.md) § Walls and § Closure):** of the three breaking parameters, the speed makes no dipole and is pinned by Cherenkov ([moving-source-gravity-bounds](../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md)); the source delay is a rigid offset the Sun's dynamical centre excludes at \(A_1<4\times10^{-12}\); the dissipative parameter's dipole is locked to a first-order self-acceleration of the Sun of at least \(0.31\,\Gamma\) m/s² in a fixed inertial direction, which the house ephemeris floor ([solar-system-ephemeris-precision-floor](../../studies/solar-system-ephemeris-precision-floor.md), Saturn \(3\times10^{-13}\) to Uranus \(3\times10^{-14}\) m/s²) caps at \(\ell_\Gamma>10\)–\(100\) kpc and hence \(A_1(10\,{\rm kpc})\lesssim10^{-3}\) to \(3\times10^{-5}\) — \(10^{2}\)–\(3\times10^{3}\) below the observed scale on every reading. The four walls named on the card ([lorentz-violation-bounds](../../studies/lorentz-violation-bounds.md), [scalar-gravity-ppn-constraints](../../studies/scalar-gravity-ppn-constraints.md)) bind the completion, not the dissipative parameter. Velocity scales: [lorentz-violation-bounds](../../studies/lorentz-violation-bounds.md), [milky-way-rotation-curve](../../studies/milky-way-rotation-curve.md); universality of the source equation: [source-side-universality-of-g](../../studies/source-side-universality-of-g.md)
legacy.kill: Fired 2026-09-04 on the solar-system self-acceleration wall.
legacy.comparator: The specified boost-invariant control (Heaviside/Carlip, eq. 2 of the chapter) in the substrate frame; the solar-system confrontation is against the Newtonian-omission ephemeris floor, not a Galilean U+v picture.
